title: sys_audit_log: mark in-product AI writes (AI on behalf of a person, conversation id, confirmation id)
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Part of objectstack-ai/cloud#3826, phase 2. Ruled on objectstack-ai/cloud#3826 by the account owner in seat session `session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9`: 「3826 照建议（征询版）」 (decision request 6890278459 and the revised D1 that follows it). Priority per the owner: 「分拆的任务能否直接标记为高优先级让车队开放」.

## 维护者速读

1. **要做的**：普通审计日志里，标出哪些修改是 AI 替某人做的、在哪次对话、经哪次确认。
2. **为什么**：现在产品内 AI 改的数据，在审计日志里和人手改的一模一样，回答不了「这条记录是 AI 替张三在哪次对话里改的」。这是对客户说「全程审计」的前提。
3. **需要你做的**：无。

## Facts

`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts:2117-2120` and `:2270-2275` write `performed_by` / `on_behalf_of` only for OAuth-client calls. Measured 🟡 on cloud#4355 G4.

## Change

Accept AI-on-behalf, conversation id and confirmation id on the write context, using the existing `performed_by` / `on_behalf_of` columns plus contract fields. Do not add a new actor vocabulary. Rows for human edits are unchanged. Add tests.
